completionCriteria.publish: only routed persistent publishes with publisher confirms count complete
completionCriteria.routingErrors: mandatory publishes are observed through ReturnListener and count as errors
completionCriteria.rejections: negative publisher confirms count as errors
completionCriteria.settlement: consumer basic.ack send time is measured; basic.ack has no broker confirmation
completionCriteria.brokerState: queueDeclarePassive ready-message count is observed after ACK sends; it does not count unacked deliveries
